const getMgmtFeePctByProject = `-- name: GetMgmtFeePctByProject :one

SELECT COALESCE(c.mgmt_fee_pct, 0) AS mgmt_fee_pct
FROM e_project p
LEFT JOIN e_project_category c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.deleted = 0
WHERE p.id = $1 AND p.deleted = 0
`

// T21 认领管理费：入账时按项目分类费率计算
func (q *Queries) GetMgmtFeePctByProject(ctx context.Context, id int64) (pgtype.Numeric, error) {
	row := q.db.QueryRow(ctx, getMgmtFeePctByProject, id)
	var mgmt_fee_pct pgtype.Numeric
	err := row.Scan(&mgmt_fee_pct)
	return mgmt_fee_pct, err
}
